features.title: Everything your restaurant needs
features.subtitle: A complete platform, from menu to financials.

qr.title: Digital QR menu
qr.desc: Customers scan the QR at their table, view the menu and order directly from their phone. No app needed.

realtime.title: Real-time orders
realtime.desc: Each order arrives instantly at the right station — kitchen, bar or drinks. Zero paper, zero noise.

delivery.title: Delivery module
delivery.desc: Your own delivery link, zone-based fee calculation, delivery panel. No marketplace fees.

waiter.title: Waiter panel
waiter.desc: Waiters see everything ready to deliver and receive calls in real time, without having to walk around.

balance.title: Prepaid balance
balance.desc: Frequent customers load credit in advance. Pix, cash or card — all recorded in the financials.

dashboard.title: Live dashboard
dashboard.desc: Full view of open tables, active tabs and the status of each order — no page refresh needed.

access.title: Access control
access.desc: Create logins per employee with roles. Each person accesses only what they need.

financial.title: Financial management
financial.desc: Revenue, average ticket and top customers. Real data from your restaurant, no spreadsheet needed.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: In 4 simple steps, your restaurant is already running with Menuê+.

s1.title: QR code at the table
s1.desc: Print and stick it. The customer scans it and is already on your restaurant's menu.

s2.title: Customer places the order
s2.desc: Chooses items, adds notes and confirms. As simple as sending a message.

s3.title: Kitchen receives it instantly
s3.desc: The order appears on the correct station screen in seconds. No shouting, no confusion.

s4.title: Waiter delivers
s4.desc: Automatic notification when an item is ready. One click to confirm delivery.
